name: io.github.wulfkaal/corpus
description: Read-only access to two explicitly separate layers: the published scholarly corpus of Prof. Wulf A. Kaal (5,655 atomic claims from 138 claim-covered works) and the TrustCarry Protocol v0.3 public research-record collections (77 author-affirmed claims and 9 internal software observations). TrustCarry was historically titled Persona Protocol v0.3. Its source manuscript remains unpublished, and its records are not part of the 5,655 scholarly layer.

publicPositions.sourceClass: owner-authorized dated commentary with explicit lifecycle status
publicPositions.relationship: Each position explicitly extends a protected scholarly claim but is not a verbatim paper claim.
publicPositions.reportingBoundary: All indexed response claims are published public records with canonical URLs.

licenseScope: The MIT License covers the server code and bundle only. Corpus content keeps its own rights: AFMR and TrustCarry records are CC BY 4.0, and other claim records may be read, indexed, quoted and cited with attribution to their canonical URL.

related_servers.name: kaal-answer-service
related_servers.description: Source-bound retrieval over the 1,330-claim agentic claim graph. Returns exact passages, citations, content hashes, scope conditions and limitations. Creates no claims and affirms none.

toolsNote: These are the tools the bundle at `bundle` actually serves, read from its own manifest.json. An earlier revision of this file listed the tools of the hosted endpoint it used to name, and kept that list when the endpoint was removed, so it advertised tools nothing served.

toolsNotCurrentlyServed.reason: These were served by a hosted endpoint that is no longer published. No current endpoint or bundle serves them.
toolsNotCurrentlyServed.staticEquivalents: The underlying records remain published as static files; see staticMirror below for the claim, position and TrustCarry research surfaces.
